name: Approximate Image-Space Multidirectional Occlusion Shading (ISMOS)
aliases: Approximate Image-Space Multidirectional Occlusion Shading (ISMOS) model
definition: A shading model that computes occlusion factors in image space to simulate shadows, ambient occlusion, and multi-directional lighting for volume rendering, using approximate opacity derived from transmittance.
summary: ISMOS is a screen-space shading technique that computes multidirectional occlusion using depth and normal buffers, differing from prior models by sampling along the pixel-to-light ray to enable multiple directional lights with minor overhead.
